explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/611: if all maximal cliques of an n-vertex G have ≥ cn vertices, is τ(G) = o_c(n)? The statement says: ∀ c > 0, ∀ ε > 0, for all large n, every G on Fin n whose maximal cliques all have ≥ cn vertices has τ(G) ≤ εn, uniformly over such G. cliqueTransversalNumber ignores 1-vertex maximal cliques, which is irrelevant here since cn ≥ 2 for large n. Faithful.
